result.summary: Shrivana Textile Mills currently has three open overdue notifications totaling INR 21M across two policies (TCI-WT-2026-0001 and TCI-SCF-2026-0001), the oldest being 50 days past due since 2026-10-04. Resolution lag on past overdues has been worsening (10→14→22 days late over the last three cycles), and notification volume has doubled in the latest 6-month window (4 vs 2) spanning two policies simultaneously, indicating building payment stress. Exposure under the WT line (17M open, plus 25M not-yet-due) is approaching its 80M limit's practical utilization pace, warranting closer monitoring of the SCF line draw as well.
concerns: Oldest overdue (50 DPD) remains unresolved on the working capital policy
Days-late on resolved invoices trending upward (10→14→22 days)
Notification frequency doubled in the last 6 months and now spans two policies concurrently, suggesting liquidity stress spreading across funding channels
Combined open + not-yet-due exposure on WT policy (approx. 42M) is more than half of the 80M limit, reducing headroom
